title: PIT CS2 Controller W0 Safety Envelope
description: Versioned, machine-validatable safety envelope per GOVERNANCE_FAILURE_OUTENGINEERING_STRATEGY.md Section 5.1. Configured once by an authorised human-CS2 decision, readable by every workflow, and enforced by a supervisor independent of the delivery agents. maximum_stage_attempts carries no const/default and is never read by any enforcement function in this W0 scope; maximum_merge_attempts and expiry remain required fields but are explicitly-tagged proposal-only/approved-active status objects that must never silently activate a default.

maximum_stage_attempts.description: Required field, proposal-only in W0: no const/default is declared and no controller enforcement function reads this field, so it can never silently activate a limit. Explicit human-CS2 activation of a stage-attempt ceiling requires a separate, future, explicitly-approved change.

maximum_merge_attempts.description: Required field, proposal-only in W0 per explicit CS2 ruling (2026-10-05): carries no const/default. Must always be an explicitly-tagged status object -- 'proposed' (unactivated) unless a separate, explicit human-CS2 decision sets 'approved_active' with a value.

expiry.description: Required field, proposal-only in W0 per explicit CS2 ruling (2026-10-05): carries no const/default. Must always be an explicitly-tagged status object -- 'proposed' (unactivated) unless a separate, explicit human-CS2 decision sets 'approved_active' with an ISO-8601 value.

reset_authority.description: Restricted to human-CS2-only. No webhook, agent, token, comment, pull_request, or automatic_retry source is a valid enum value; a tripped circuit breaker can never be reset by any automated path.
